title: RoboShape: Information-Theoretic Point Cloud Representations for Privacy-Aware Robot Perception
abstract: arXiv:2608.21380v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the increased adoption of robotic agents operating in human environments by scanning and sharing 3D representations (e.g., for fleet learning, cloud-based planning, or collaborative mapping), collected point clouds reveal not just the objects in a scene but also sensitive spatial context, such as room function or information that occupants never consented to disclose. Traditional point cloud encoders offer no principled control over this: either all is preserved, or none. Hence, we introduce RoboShape, an information theory guided compression head following the frozen {\tt Sonata} encoder. We project voxel-level embeddings using the Donsker-Varadhan formulation of mutual information (MI). Specifically, we maximize the MI between embeddings and object-level understanding while minimizing it for private attributes. translated_title: RoboShape：面向隐私感知机器人感知的信息论点云表示
translated_abstract: 随着机器人代理在人类环境中通过扫描和共享3D表示（例如，用于车队学习、基于云的规划或协作地图构建）的日益普及，收集到的点云不仅揭示了场景中的物体，还暴露了敏感的空间上下文，如房间功能或居住者从未同意披露的信息。传统的点云编码器对此缺乏原则性的控制：要么保留所有信息，要么什么都不保留。因此，我们引入了RoboShape，一种在冻结的Sonata编码器之后的信息论引导压缩头。我们使用互信息的Donsker-Varadhan公式来投影体素级嵌入。具体来说，我们最大化嵌入与物体级理解之间的互信息，同时最小化与私有属性相关的互信息。RoboShape使得嵌入大小减少87.5%，同时保留了98.7%的物体分类实用性，并有效抑制了敏感信息的泄露。
tldr: RoboShape通过信息论引导的压缩头，在保持物体分类性能的同时大幅减小点云嵌入尺寸，并有效抑制敏感属性的泄露。
en_tdlr: RoboShape uses an information-theoretic compression head to significantly reduce point cloud embedding size while preserving object classification performance and suppressing sensitive attribute leakage.
